1.text: “Ndi umuzabibu w'ukuri, kandi Data ni nyirawo uwuhingira.

2.text: Ishami ryose ryo muri jye ritera imbuto arikuraho, iryera imbuto ryose aryanganyaho amahage yaryo ngo rirusheho kwera imbuto.

4.text: Mugume muri jye, nanjye ngume muri mwe. Nk'uko ishami ritabasha kwera imbuto ubwaryo ritagumye mu muzabibu, ni ko namwe mutabibasha nimutaguma muri jye.

5.text: “Ni jye muzabibu, namwe muri amashami. Uguma muri jye nanjye nkaguma muri we, uwo ni we wera imbuto nyinshi, kuko ari nta cyo mubasha gukora mutamfite.

6.text: Umuntu utaguma muri jye ajugunywa hanze nk'ishami ryumye, maze bakayateranya bakayajugunya mu muriro agashya.

7.text: Nimuguma muri jye amagambo yanjye akaguma muri mwe, musabe icyo mushaka cyose muzagihabwa.

8.text: Ibyo ni byo byubahisha Data, ni uko mwera imbuto nyinshi, mukaba abigishwa banjye.

9.text: “Uko Data yankunze ni ko nanjye nabakunze. Nuko rero mugume mu rukundo rwanjye.

10.text: Nimwitondera amategeko yanjye muzaguma mu rukundo rwanjye, nk'uko nanjye nitondeye amategeko ya Data nkaguma mu rukundo rwe.

11.text: “Ibyo mbibabwiriye kugira ngo umunezero wanjye ube muri mwe, kandi n'umunezero wanyu ube wuzuye.

12.text: Ngiri itegeko ryanjye: mukundane nk'uko nabakunze.

13.text: Nta wufite urukundo ruruta urw'umuntu upfira incuti ze.

14.text: Muri incuti zanjye, nimukora ibyo mbategeka.

15.text: Sinkibita abagaragu kuko umugaragu atazi ibyo shebuja akora, ahubwo mbise incuti kuko ibyo numvise kuri Data byose mbibamenyesheje.

16.text: Si mwe mwantoranyije, ahubwo ni jye wabatoranyije kandi mbashyiriraho kugira ngo mugende mwere imbuto, imbuto zanyu zigumeho kugira ngo icyo muzasaba Data cyose mu izina ryanjye akibahe.

18.text: “Ab'isi nibabanga, mumenye ko babanje kunyanga batarabanga.

19.text: Iyo muba ab'isi, ab'isi baba babakunze. Ariko kuko mutari ab'isi, ahubwo nabatoranyije mu b'isi, ni cyo gituma ab'isi babanga.

20.text: Mwibuke ijambo nababwiye nti ‘Umugaragu ntaruta shebuja.’ Niba bandenganyije namwe bazabarenganya, niba bitondeye ijambo ryanjye, n'iryanyu na ryo bazaryitondera.

21.text: Ariko ibyo byose bazabibagirira babahora izina ryanjye, kuko batazi Uwantumye uwo ari we.

22.text: Iyaba ntaje ngo mvugane na bo ntibaba bafite icyaha, ariko noneho ntibafite uko biregura icyaha cyabo.

24.text: Iyaba ntakoreye muri bo imirimo itakozwe n'undi muntu, nta cyaha baba bafite. Ariko noneho barayibonye, nyamara baratwanga jyewe na Data.

25.text: Ariko byabaye bityo kugira ngo ijambo risohore, ryanditswe mu mategeko yabo ngo ‘Banyangiye ubusa.’

26.text: “Umufasha naza, uwo nzaboherereza ava kuri Data, ari we Mwuka w'ukuri ukomoka kuri Data, azampamya.

27.text: Kandi namwe muzampamya, kuko uhereye mbere na mbere mwari kumwe nanjye.
